\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-82},
  title = {Blanked-out optional fields in training are measured under a rule fixed before the first fit},
  date = {2026-10-13},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Modelling Approach, Model Evaluation},
  participants = {@kadameit proposed it (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/116}{issue \#116}); @lukas2510 decided to measure it and left the protocol to the AI},
  decision = {We measured whether training \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} on copies of the listings with optional fields blanked out removes its collapse on sparse requests, the reason \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} is the candidate (\hyperref[EDN-62]{EDN-62}).
Configurations, scenarios and rule were committed before the first fit; the test split was not read.
Under the rule no configuration replaces the candidate; whether the pipeline adopts blanking is decided separately.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item \textbf{Option A (measured): train with blanked-out fields.}
One model for every request, but more training rows.
\item \textbf{Option B: serve both models, routed by how full a request is.}
Two models and a threshold, and still 8.57\,\% on a required-only request.
\item \textbf{Option C: keep \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} without measuring.}
The project brief's open masking question stays open.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} All 23 optional fields are empty together in 5 of 60,378 training rows, so a required-only request lies outside what the model saw.
With one fully and one randomly blanked copy of every row, \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}extended} answers it at 7.14\,\% validation MdAPE instead of 10.79\,\%, passes SC-06 at 1.14x and answers a complete request at 6.29\,\% instead of 6.45\,\%.
It beats \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} at every level of sparsity, but is measurably worse on a request giving exactly the basic set's six fields, 7.12\,\% against 6.96\,\%, which the rule excludes.
The same copies take \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} itself from 8.57\,\% to 7.19\,\% on the required-only request.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Used as input for further analysis},
  assessment = {AI corrected the issue's premise: the fields are often empty singly, almost never together.
It proposed configurations and rule and wrote the script.
An independent agent's review before the fits extended the rule to every incomplete request, the condition that then failed.
No person reviewed the protocol.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-13 on issue \#116: ``validate that this is a good idea and how we best test it, then test it''.},
